public_api.note: LOT-21 / 0.5.0a1 introduces the first framework-neutral user-facing facade: AccountingApplication with references, charts, entries, ledger, closing, controls, imports, statements, reporting, analysis and subledgers namespaces; immutable stdlib DTOs; CommandContext; cursor-first Page; and machine-readable public boundary errors. Public operations delegate only to composed application services, reject Django/SQLAlchemy-derived return values, and expose no ORM/session/transaction API. This alpha does not freeze the pre-1.0 Python API; LOT-22 remains responsible for extension contracts, deterministic manifest generation and compatibility formalization.
